title: Oops, I Did It Again: Reversing G/L Transactions in Business Central
summary: The post explains three methods to reverse General Ledger transactions in Business Central: batch reversal via G/L Register, correction entries with correction flags, and transaction-level reversal from G/L Entries. Each method maintains audit trails with balancing entries rather than deleting original entries.
key_points: Reverse Register on the G/L Registers page undoes a whole posted journal batch with balancing entries and a REVERSAL source code
Register reversal only works for registers from journal posting, not from modules such as sales or purchasing
The correction flag method copies selected lines from Posted General Journal into a new journal, flips signs and posts them, which requires the Copy to Posted Jnl. Lines option on the batch
Reverse Transaction on General Ledger Entries targets a single transaction; reversals post on the original posting date
All methods keep the audit trail by adding offsetting entries instead of deleting originals
features: Copy Selected Lines to General Journal
Copy to Posted Jnl. Lines option
